title: Hunts FH-042T: Decide and test the choice-group race in hunt_claim_apply against real Postgres

source.ref: Split from FH-042S (2026-11-16): the answer form, the locked-Mystery projection and the fork and Mystery authoring shipped dark; the SQL decision and the live race run move here.

detail: Requires FH-042S. Today an exclusive choice is enforced in TypeScript: claimAsPlayer evaluates the graph and hunt_claim_apply compares the progress count under the run lock, so of two branches claimed at once the second answers stale_progress, rereads and is refused. A staff approval does not take that path, which is the gap named in FH-042. Owed: (1) a decision, recorded as an ADR, on whether hunt_claim_apply should itself refuse a credit for a second member of a choice_group on the same run; if yes, the migration goes through the serial database gate and the staff approval path inherits it; (2) a pgTAP test, or a recorded live two-session run, of two members of one choice group claimed at once on one run against real Postgres, showing exactly one credit. Done when supabase/tests/hunt_choice_race.test.sql exists and passes in the db-tests workflow, and the ADR is filed. Owner role: Game systems. Hunts switches stay OFF.
